description_en: Modifies the name, switch status, action for unidentified applications, or custom actions for built-in applications of an application template. The template ID must belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 修改应用程序模板的名称、开关状态、未识别应用动作或内置应用自定义动作。模板ID必须属于当前阿里云账号
name: UpdateApplicationTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application template to be modified. The template must exist within the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的应用程序模板ID。必须为当前阿里云账号下已存在的模板
parameters.name: application_template_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the application template. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.). It cannot contain spaces. If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序模板名称。长度为1~64个字符，支持中文、英文字母、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和半角句号（.），不能包含空格。不传或传空时保持原值
parameters.name: application_template_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the application template. The description can be up to 128 characters in length. If this parameter is not specified, the original value is retained. If an empty string is specified, the description is cleared
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序模板的描述信息。长度不超过128个字符。不传该参数时保持原值，传入空字符串时清空描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The master switch status of the application template. Valid values:
Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled.
If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh:
应用程序模板总开关状态。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭。
不传或传空时保持原值
parameters.name: template_status

parameters.help_en: The switch status of built-in application control. Valid values: only Enable is supported. If you specify Disable, an error is returned. If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh: 内置应用管控开关状态。取值仅支持Enable；传入Disable会返回错误。不传或传空时保持原值
parameters.name: built_in_application_status

parameters.help_en:
The switch status of custom rules for applications. Valid values:
Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled.
If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh:
应用程序自定义规则开关状态。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭。
不传或传空时保持原值
parameters.name: custom_rule_status

parameters.help_en:
The action for unidentified applications. Valid values:
Allow: Allow.
Alert: Monitor.
Deny: Block.
If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh:
未识别应用的处置动作。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截。
不传或传空时保持原值
parameters.name: unknown_action

fields.help_en:
The action to be performed on the application. Valid values:
Allow: Allow.
Alert: Monitor.
Deny: Block
fields.help_zh:
对该应用程序执行的动作。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截
fields.name: action

fields.help_en: The ID of the application for which to set custom actions. The application must exist in the built-in application signature library and the ID cannot be 0. You can call the ListApplications operation to query the ID
fields.help_zh: 要设置自定义动作的应用程序ID。必须为内置应用特征库中已存在的应用，不能为0。可通过ListApplications查询
fields.name: application_id

parameters.help_en: The list of custom actions to be added or updated for built-in applications. This list is merged with RemoveBuiltInApplicationCustomActions by removing items first and then adding items. The same application ID cannot appear in both lists at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 新增或更新的内置应用自定义动作列表。与RemoveBuiltInApplicationCustomActions按先删后加合并，同一应用程序ID不得同时出现在两个列表中
parameters.name: add_built_in_application_custom_actions

fields.help_en: The ID of the application from which to remove custom actions. The application must exist in the built-in application signature library
fields.help_zh: 要移除自定义动作的应用程序ID。必须为内置应用特征库中已存在的应用
fields.name: application_id

parameters.help_en: The list of built-in applications from which to remove custom actions. After removal, these applications revert to the default actions of the template. The same application ID cannot appear in AddBuiltInApplicationCustomActions at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 要移除自定义动作的内置应用列表。移除后这些应用恢复为模板默认动作。同一应用程序ID不得同时出现在AddBuiltInApplicationCustomActions中
parameters.name: remove_built_in_application_custom_actions
